Streaming chat completion via the AWS Bedrock provider using the bedrock/ prefix — verifies SSE chunks are yielded and assembled correctly from the Converse streaming API

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	request := pkg.ChatCompletionRequest{
		Model:     `bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0`,
		Stream:    ptr(true),
		MaxTokens: ptr(uint64(32)),
	}
		client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.ChatStream(request)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
